behavior: Retrying a failed Validate stage now restarts from Generate because failed snapshots do not persist generated results.
Retry resets the failed stage and any downstream stages back to pending.
Retry clears result on re-entry and clears extracted only when the retry restarts at or before Extract.
Retry metadata remains on the persisted job record.
Failed jobs expose an in-place Retry job action on the results page.
Completed jobs with evidence.failures expose a workbench-level Resume coverage action.
Both actions call the existing GET /api/jobs/:jobId?retry=1 surface and then reuse the existing polling lifecycle.

jobContract.note: No new route contract fields were required.
